subject: Web Development
title: The Web Platform Today
description: A 60-second lesson on The Web Platform Today.

hook.text: The web started as linked documents. Now it runs 3D games, video editors, and AI.

buildup.text: WebAssembly, WebGPU, and modern APIs turned browsers into full application platforms.

discovery.text: Figma runs in the browser. Photoshop has a web version. VS Code works online.

twist.text: Desktop apps are migrating to the web, not the other way around.

climax.text: The browser became the operating system nobody predicted back in 1989.

punchline.text: The browser is the new operating system.

quiz.question: What technology lets compiled code run in the browser at near-native speed?
